module Main (main) where

import System.IO

main :: IO ()
main = do
  contents <- getContents
  let (tLine : rest) = lines contents
      t = read tLine :: Int
      results = map check (take t rest)
  mapM_ putStrLn results

check :: String -> String
check s = if go 0 s then "YES" else "NO"
  where
    go _ [] = True
    go bal (c:cs)
      | bal < 0 = False
      | c == '(' = go (bal + 1) cs
      | otherwise = go (bal - 1) cs
    -- final balance must be zero
